test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following taxes has been replaced by Goods and Services Tax (GST)?

1. Additional Duty of Customs

2. State VAT

3. Central Excise Duty
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1, 2 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** was implemented in India on **July 1, 2017** to streamline indirect taxation.
 
• GST replaced various indirect taxes imposed by the **central and state governments**, simplifying the tax structure.
